duplicate_grading: Both reviewers checked identical outputs consistently. Counts refer to 9 source tasks per arm, not 27 independent source tasks or 54 human observations.

root_source_audit.scope: Read C03/C05/C06/C07 full sources, selected passages, anchors and all three outputs after blind reviews. No response or grade was changed.
root_source_audit.C05: All arms retain two of three requested information units under explicit keep_limits. Manual/revised omit competition-driven adaptation; current omits the auto-show promotional-model change. All omissions are permitted by the selected policy, visible in coverage and not counted as fabricated facts.
root_source_audit.C06: All arms omit the apology under keep_limits and retain the incident and announced investigation. The summary identifies the TV host by role but does not retain the full personal name; reviewers accept this as the central incident anchor under the frozen contextual-reference rubric. The aggregate does not certify preservation of every name or all source details.
root_source_audit.B001_B010: v3 lexical-overlap hints fall slightly below 1 (0.9667/0.9714); both blinded semantic reviews accept the rewritten clauses. Proper names, dates, technical terms and retained source phrases contribute to overlap. These hints are not semantic failures; no threshold or prompt was retuned after observing outputs. The heuristic remains limited.

interpretation: All three arms tie in this small explicit-priority study. No superior content preservation, statistical equivalence, human preference inference or usability improvement was established. The deterministic conflict feature is validated separately from generated-summary quality. No global automatic summary evaluator is claimed to be fixed or complete.
